verdict.rationale: Community reports describe a 'Portable Computer' variant that runs Perplexity's harness locally, but only on a user-supplied NVIDIA DGX Spark (comm-2, comm-8). It is also closed source, needs a Pro or Max subscription (comm-3), and Perplexity's cloud orchestrator still decides what escalates to the cloud (comm-1), so this is tethered local execution rather than true self-hosting. All first-party docs describe only the cloud-hosted service and MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting documentation, deployment on arbitrary hardware, operation without Perplexity's cloud or subscription, open-source or deployable artifacts, and hands-on corroboration.
